core_obligations: Reindex the correction sum over pairs (xi, Z) with Z an integral closed subscheme of dimension d, observing that the length m_Z is finite and vanishes unless Z is one of the Z_i (proof lines 10311-10327).

Prove additivity of the functional E(F) on short exact sequences of coherent modules with support of dimension at most d, using additivity of Euler characteristics and of lengths (proof lines 10328-10335).

Apply the coherent filtration lemma to write F as a successive extension of sheaves of the form (V_j -> X)_*I_j with V_j integral of dimension at most d, so that additivity reduces the claim to those subquotients (proof lines 10336-10357).
Settle the case where the support has dimension < d: the first term has total degree < d by the cited polynomial lemma and the second term vanishes (proof lines 10358-10362).

Settle the case dim(V) = d using the short exact sequence 0 -> (V->X)_*I -> (V->X)_*O_V -> (V->X)_*(O_V/I) -> 0: the middle term gives E = 0 by the projection formula and the relative-affine comparison, and the right-hand term has support of dimension < d, which gives the left-hand term (proof lines 10363-10385).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the correction term as a sum over top-dimensional integral closed subschemes with finite lengths.
Establish additivity of the resulting functional.
Reduce by a coherent filtration to pushforwards of ideal sheaves on integral subschemes.
Handle the low-dimensional case by degree reasons and the top-dimensional case by a short exact sequence, the projection formula and induction.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the top-degree behaviour of chi(X, F tensor L_1^{n_1} tensor ... tensor L_r^{n_r}): the difference from the sum of m_i chi(Z_i, L^{n}|_{Z_i}) over the top-dimensional components of the support is a numerical polynomial of total degree strictly less than d = dim Supp(F). The proof recasts the expression as a functional E(F) over integral closed subschemes, proves additivity of E along short exact sequences using additivity of Euler characteristics and of lengths, filters F by subsheaves whose subquotients are pushed-forward ideal sheaves on integral subschemes, reduces to those subquotients, and handles the middle term by the projection formula with the identification of the cohomology of a closed immersion pushforward (proof lines 10311-10385). H3: the reduction through the coherent filtration together with the length-weighted bookkeeping is an independent research-level argument.
